title: Django, ASGI server
notes: The generated Django project with synchronous views on Uvicorn (ASGI) in place of a WSGI server. Django's documentation says synchronous views are slower this way.
details: The Django entry with one change: the server. Served through the generated config/asgi.py by Uvicorn (one process, loop=asyncio, http=h11, lifespan off, access log off) on a thread inside the one measured process, in place of WSGI on Waitress. Settings, middleware and the synchronous views are the same, so Django runs each view on a thread through sync_to_async, which its documentation describes as a performance penalty.
